entries.english:
German Masters regarding the brothers and cousins (Hans Christoph, Conrad etc.) von Rosenberg of Waldmannshofen, revenue of the Mergentheim hospital concerning Bobstadt.

facts.subject: the brothers and cousins von Rosenberg at Waldmannshofen
facts.content: were opposed by the Teutonic Order in a dispute over the Mergentheim Hospital’s rent at Bobstadt.
